Product:{\"sku\":\"7100126113\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
SMASH YOUR WAY THROUGH THE APOCALYPSE
The world has fallen to the infected but there's still plenty worth saving... and even more worth smashing! Explore abandoned streets, ruined buildings and forgotten corners of a world left in pieces. Grab your Breaker Tool, tear through obstacles and collect useful materials hidden among the wreckage. From broken furniture to piles of junk, almost everything is an opportunity to gather resources and move forward.

SCAVENGE, REPAIR, REPEAT
Wood, metal, spare parts and other supplies are the keys to making progress. Gather what you need, trade materials and put abandoned machinery back to work. Repair damaged equipment, reconnect pipes and wires and find missing components to get old systems running again. Sometimes the best way forward is to smash something. Other times, you'll actually have to fix it!

GEAR UP AND FIGHT BACK
Of course, the zombies haven't gone anywhere! Fight off infected enemies as you explore, then prepare for tougher encounters by upgrading your weapons, equipment, and Breaker Tool. Discover new gear, merge matching items to improve your equipment and unlock powerful perks that make you stronger. The better your gear, the more you can break, collect and survive!

EVERY DAY IS A NEW SURVIVAL STORY
Follow missions, meet survivors and discover new areas as you make your way through the aftermath. Search for valuable supplies, help restore damaged locations and take on different objectives along the way. Need a change of pace? Try your hand at fishing before heading back into the action. Just don't get too comfortable. The infected don't take days off!

FEATURES:
• Destructible Environments - Smash objects, clear obstacles and collect valuable resources
• Zombie Combat - Fight infected enemies and prepare for tougher encounters
• Resource Gathering - Collect wood, metal, electronic parts and other useful materials
• Exploration & Missions - Discover new locations and complete story objectives
• Repairs & Crafting - Gather materials to repair machines, equipment and damaged structures
• Interactive Puzzles - Connect pipes, match wires and solve different repair challenges
• Survivor Encounters - Meet characters and help them survive the apocalypse
• Extra Activities - Trade resources, complete additional tasks or go fishing!
• Breaker Tool Upgrades - Increase your breaking power to destroy tougher obstacles
• Weapons & Equipment - Upgrade your gear and strengthen your survivor
• Powerful Perks - Unlock useful bonuses to boost your abilities

There's always something to smash, something to fix and another zombie to fight!
